reference_implementations.title:
HyPINO: Multi-Physics Neural Operators via HyperPINNs and the Method of
  Manufactured Solutions
reference_implementations.tldr: HyPINO, a multi-physics neural operator using a Swin Transformer-based hypernetwork, achieves zero-shot generalization across parametric PDEs and outperforms existing methods with iterative refinement and efficient fine-tuning.

reference_implementations.title: Respecting causality is all you need for training physics-informed neural networks
reference_implementations.tldr: Proposed modifications to PINN loss functions improve accuracy and convergence by explicitly accounting for physical causality, enabling successful simulation of chaotic and turbulent systems.
